_comment: Worked example from the HRIS API board. Shows all four placement modes: a new parent with nested children, attachment to an existing parent by id, per-task status override, and a status correction on an already-created task.

tasks.name: Attendance
tasks.description: Capture time in and time out. Biometric devices feed it, payroll reads it.

children.name: Attendance Records
children.description: List, add, correct, remove a day per employee.

children.name: Attendance Devices
children.description: Register biometric devices. Rotate the device key.

children.name: Biometric Intake
children.description: Device pushes punches. Throttled and deduped.

children.name: Intake Replay
children.description: Inspect raw payloads. Replay a failed batch.

children.name: Attendance Export
children.description: Export a cutoff period's attendance for payroll.

children.name: My Attendance
children.description: Own attendance log. Punch in and out from the app.

tasks.name: Employee Cases
tasks.description: Employee relations records. NTE, warnings, commendations. Confidential by default.

children.name: Case Types
children.description: Catalog of case types per company.

children.name: Case Filing
children.description: Open a case. Reference number per type per year.

children.name: Case Resolution
children.description: Resolve and close on a terminal status.

children.name: Case Confidentiality
children.description: Who may read a case. Subject, raiser, handler, admin.

children.name: Case Statistics
children.description: Counts scoped to what the caller may read.

children.name: My Cases
children.description: Raise a case, respond to one, withdraw it.

tasks.name: Payslip Correction
tasks.description: Supersede a released payslip. Originals stay immutable.

tasks.name: Role Assignment
tasks.description: Bulk assign and remove users on a role. Additive.
